ui.tagline: From first camp to future state
ui.deck: Choose a homeland on a living Earth. Build a tribe, unite a region, and carry its history into the future.
ui.detailHelp: Detailed loads one higher pre-rendered map level; Economy loads one lower. Simulation detail is unchanged.
ui.surveyHelp: Show biome, elevation, allegiance and influence while hovering.
ui.mapInstructions: Left click or drag selects · Right click moves · Ctrl-right-click queues · Middle drag pans
ui.paceNote: Slope and vegetation adjust pace continuously · travels in daylight from {start}–{end}
ui.worldAtlasLabel: World Atlas with interactive Regional Theaters

diplomacy.title: Diplomacy
diplomacy.introduction: Relations are shaped by deeds, promises, and remembered injuries. Agreements require contact, knowledge, and the consent of both tribes.
diplomacy.awaitingResponse: This proposal is already awaiting a response.
diplomacy.wrongWarState: This action is unavailable in the current war state.
diplomacy.actionSent: {action} will be carried out on the next command tick.

send-envoys.name: Send envoys
send-envoys.description: Offer gifts and careful words to improve relations.

insult.name: Deliver an insult
insult.description: Publicly slight their standing and provoke resentment.

threaten.name: Threaten
threaten.description: Demand deference by invoking the strength of your warriors.

declare-war.name: Declare war
declare-war.description: End every agreement and begin open conflict.

propose-guest-right.name: Propose guest right
propose-guest-right.description: Promise shelter and protection to peaceful visitors.

propose-safe-passage.name: Propose safe passage
propose-safe-passage.description: Permit travelers to cross each other's lands unharmed.

propose-non-aggression.name: Propose non-aggression
propose-non-aggression.description: Swear not to raid or attack one another.

propose-exchange-pact.name: Propose exchange pact
propose-exchange-pact.description: Formalize recurring exchanges of goods and knowledge.

propose-defensive-pact.name: Propose defensive pact
propose-defensive-pact.description: Promise mutual aid against outside attackers.

offer-peace.name: Offer peace
offer-peace.description: Ask to end the war without a standing pact.

events.title: Events
events.introduction: Encounters arise from the world, your scouts, the camp, research, and relations. Decisions pause the game; reports remain in the chronicle.
events.noEventsDescription: New reports and decisions will be recorded here as the tribe explores and grows.

first-contact.title: First contact
first-contact.body: People of {target} have been encountered. They watch for the custom by which we will greet them.

proposal-received.title: A proposal arrives
proposal-received.body: Envoys from {target} wait by the outer fires with terms for the council.

proposal-refused.title: Envoys return alone
proposal-refused.body: {target} has refused our proposal. The rejection will be remembered.

pact-sealed.title: Words made binding
pact-sealed.body: An agreement with {target} has been witnessed and accepted by both tribes.

war-declared.title: Open conflict
war-declared.body: Peace with {target} has ended. Old agreements no longer bind either side.

battle-won.title: The enemy breaks
battle-won.body: Our warband has forced the fighters of {target} from the field. Pursuit policy decided the cost.

battle-lost.title: Our line breaks
battle-lost.body: Our fighters have yielded the field to {target}. Survivors are retreating toward familiar ground.

work-completed.title: Work completed
work-completed.body: A new work stands ready at {settlement}.

unit-trained.title: A company is ready
unit-trained.body: The people trained at {settlement} are ready to receive orders.

research-breakthrough.title: Practice becomes tradition
research-breakthrough.body: Repeated trials have produced reliable knowledge that the tribe can now teach.

disputed-hunting-ground.title: Disputed hunting ground
disputed-hunting-ground.body: Hunters from a neighboring tribe claim the same seasonal ground as ours.

envoys-at-dusk.title: Envoys at dusk
envoys-at-dusk.body: Unexpected visitors arrive before nightfall and ask to speak around our fire.

guest-right-tested.title: Guest right tested
guest-right-tested.body: Travelers invoke the old protection owed to peaceful guests.

shared-festival.title: A shared festival
shared-festival.body: A nearby people invite us to join a gathering beyond their hearths.

marriage-between-clans.title: A bond between clans
marriage-between-clans.body: Two families ask the council to bless a union across tribal lines.

hidden-spring.title: A hidden spring
hidden-spring.body: A scout finds fresh water concealed beneath brush and stone.

commanding-ridge.title: A commanding ridge
commanding-ridge.body: The high ground opens a broad view across the surrounding country.

dangerous-crossing.title: A dangerous crossing
dangerous-crossing.body: The direct path continues through water and unstable ground.

abandoned-hearth.title: An abandoned hearth
abandoned-hearth.body: Cold ashes and worked fragments reveal a place left behind long ago.

unfamiliar-trail.title: An unfamiliar trail
unfamiliar-trail.body: Fresh marks cross the scout's path and lead toward unknown ground.

wounded-scout.title: A wounded scout
wounded-scout.body: A field runner returns hurt and cannot finish the route alone.

crowded-hearth.title: Crowded hearths
crowded-hearth.body: Families press close around shelters no longer large enough for them.

spoiled-stores.title: Spoiled stores
spoiled-stores.body: Damp and pests have ruined part of the camp's gathered food.

clay-deposit.title: A workable clay deposit
clay-deposit.body: Useful clay lies exposed near the camp after recent weather.

skilled-craftsperson.title: A skilled craftsperson
skilled-craftsperson.body: One worker's patient method produces unusually dependable tools.

night-watch.title: The night watch
night-watch.body: Arguments grow over who should guard the camp after darkness.

fresh-water-concern.title: Fresh-water concern
fresh-water-concern.body: The growing camp draws more heavily on its nearest clean water.

choices.dig-deeper: Dig and line a deeper well

remembered-technique.title: A remembered technique
remembered-technique.body: An elder recalls part of a method no one has used for years.

disputed-method.title: A disputed method
disputed-method.body: Two groups insist that their approach gives the more reliable result.

traveling-lorekeeper.title: A traveling lorekeeper
traveling-lorekeeper.body: A visitor offers unfamiliar stories and practical observations.

successful-experiment.title: A successful experiment
successful-experiment.body: A deliberate trial works more reliably than anyone expected.

broken-prototype.title: A broken prototype
broken-prototype.body: A promising new object fails under ordinary use.

cattle-theft.title: Livestock taken
cattle-theft.body: Tracks suggest that people from a known tribe drove animals away at night.

blood-price-demand.title: A blood-price demand
blood-price-demand.body: Another tribe demands compensation for an injury they blame on our people.

captive-warrior.title: A captive warrior
captive-warrior.body: Our people hold an armed stranger taken during a tense encounter.

raid-warning.title: Warning of a raid
raid-warning.body: Scouts report movement consistent with a war party gathering nearby.

truce-opportunity.title: An opening for truce
truce-opportunity.body: Weariness on both sides creates a brief chance to speak without weapons.

communal-feast.title: A communal feast
communal-feast.body: A successful season leaves enough food for a gathering of every household.

adoption-request.title: A family seeks adoption
adoption-request.body: A displaced household asks to join our people and share our obligations.

burial-of-elder.title: Burial of an elder
burial-of-elder.body: A respected keeper of memory has died, and the people gather to remember.

harsh-season-signs.title: Signs of a harsh season
harsh-season-signs.body: Animals, wind, and early frost all warn of difficult months ahead.

young-generation.title: The young generation
young-generation.body: A large group has reached the age to take on the tribe's adult duties.

setup.chooseCultureMessage: Move across the cultural Atlas, then choose the learned tradition your first tribe will carry.
setup.chooseCultureHelp: Move previews · Left click selects · Wheel zooms · Middle drag pans
setup.chooseCultureInvalid: Choose an inhabited land region; ocean and Antarctica have no starting culture.
setup.chooseCampHelp: Left click selects or switches Culture · Wheel zooms · Middle drag pans
setup.chooseCampMessage: Choose a Camp site inside this Regional Theater.
setup.chooseCampReach: Select clear land inside the {culture} {direction}, or click another Culture Field to adopt it before founding.
setup.waterCamp: Water cannot hold a Camp. Choose solid land.
setup.uninhabitedCamp: This land has no inhabited Culture Field and cannot hold your first Camp.
setup.culturalReach: You may found only inside that cultural reach.
setup.broadTradition: Broad learned tradition · click to select
setup.cultureSelected: {culture} selected. This is a broad learned starting tradition; its borders can overlap and change during play.
setup.cultureStillSelected: {culture} is selected. Choose another cultural field, or continue to the Theater survey.
setup.cultureCount: {count} broad Regional Cultures · learned traditions, not fixed peoples
setup.theaterSummary: {center} center · {culture} covers about {percent}% of its surveyed land in the {direction}. {restriction}
setup.invalidTheater: Choose a land-qualified Theater that overlaps the {culture} cultural field. Red outlines fall outside it.
setup.surveyTheaters: Survey any Regional Theater touching the {culture} field. Mixed-culture Theaters are valid; your Camp must begin inside the correct reach.
setup.ineligibleTooltip: {culture} has no land presence in this survey
setup.switchedCamp: Switched to {culture} and selected this Camp site. Continue to begin scouting.
setup.selectedCamp: {culture} Camp site selected. Continue to begin scouting.

loading.prepareTheater: Compiling or locating the selected geography
loading.loadingRelief: Loading relief, rivers, and terrain cells
loading.assembleSurface: Assembling terrain, vegetation, moisture, and elevation

orders.orderImpassable: Order set · the direct route crosses impassable ground.
orders.pausedOrder: Order set · press Play to travel.
orders.travelling: Travelling at the current ground and slope pace.

combat.requiresWar: Combat requires a declaration of war.
combat.orderIssued: Engage {target} on the next command tick.

construction.villageDescription: Turn this Camp into a permanent Village with organized work and local administration.
construction.villageQueued: Establishing the Village on the next command tick.

administration.requiresVillage: Specialized administrators require this Camp to become a Village.
administration.requiresTechnology: Research Village Administration to assign a specialized administrator.
administration.chooseRole: Choose one administrator for this Village. Assigning another replaces the current role.
administration.assignmentQueued: Assigning {role} on the next command tick.

tribal-leader.name: Tribal Leader
tribal-leader.description: The recognized leader settles disputes and coordinates communal work.

elder.name: Elder
elder.description: Custom, memory, and trusted judgment strengthen the Village's legitimacy.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: A dedicated keeper teaches observations, techniques, and oral records.

steward.name: Steward
steward.description: A practical organizer coordinates stores, labour, dwellings, and seasonal needs.

roster.chooseBuilding: Choose a Tribal work. Completed works improve settlement growth, influence, knowledge, or observation.
roster.chooseUnit: Choose a field group. Each group permanently assigns part of the settlement population.
roster.buildingQueued: Raising {building} on the next command tick.
roster.trainingQueued: Organizing {unit} on the next command tick.

scout-post.name: Scout Post
scout-post.description: A raised lookout for reading movement, smoke, weather, and distant terrain.

hearth.name: Communal Hearth
hearth.description: A maintained cooking and gathering fire at the settlement's social center.

hunters-shelter.name: Hunters' Shelter
hunters-shelter.description: Stores hunting gear and provides a meeting place for coordinated parties.

toolmakers-shelter.name: Toolmakers' Shelter
toolmakers-shelter.description: A dry shared workspace for grinding, hafting, repairing, and teaching toolcraft.

council-circle.name: Council Circle
council-circle.description: A recognized place for councils, judgments, guests, and common decisions.

drying-racks.name: Drying Racks
drying-racks.description: Raised racks and smoke shelters preserve meat, fish, fruit, and gathered plants.

rally-ground.name: Rally Ground
rally-ground.description: A clear mustering place for drills, signals, weapons, and organized warbands.

lore-hut.name: Lore Hut
lore-hut.description: A quiet teaching place where routes, seasons, customs, and techniques are rehearsed.

granary.name: Granary
granary.description: A managed communal store protected from damp, pests, and everyday consumption.

cultivated-fields.name: Cultivated Fields
cultivated-fields.description: Prepared plots for sowing, tending, and harvesting near the Village.

corral.name: Corral
corral.description: Fenced space for breeding, protecting, sorting, and managing domesticated animals.

pottery-kiln.name: Pottery Kiln
pottery-kiln.description: A sheltered firing place for repeatable household and storage vessels.

weavers-hut.name: Weavers' Hut
weavers-hut.description: A shared workspace for spinning, weaving, net-making, and textile instruction.

shrine.name: Communal Shrine
shrine.description: A durable gathering place for rites, memory, identity, and seasonal assembly.

well.name: Village Well
well.description: A protected source of fresh water with maintained access and drainage.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: An organized extraction face for toolstone and dependable building material.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: Ditches, timber barriers, and watch positions define a defended Village edge.

exchange-ground.name: Exchange Ground
exchange-ground.description: A customary place for visiting parties, barter, news, and guest-right.

specialist-workshop.name: Specialist Workshop
specialist-workshop.description: Dedicated craftspeople maintain tools, standards, batches, and apprenticeships.

copper-workshop.name: Copper Workshop
copper-workshop.description: A controlled workspace for cold-working, annealing, and testing native copper.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: A lone trained traveler for terrain reconnaissance and distant observation.

hunting-party.name: Hunting Party
hunting-party.description: A small coordinated group able to range, track, and defend itself in the wild.

slingers.name: Slingers
slingers.description: A dispersed missile band for harassment, screening, and fighting from rough ground.

spear-warband.name: Spear Warband
spear-warband.description: A disciplined close-order band for holding ground and meeting hostile warriors.

raiding-party.name: Raiding Party
raiding-party.description: A lightly supplied band organized for fast strikes and longer movement away from home.

axe-warband.name: Axe Warband
axe-warband.description: A close-combat band equipped with durable hafted tools suited to assault and clearing.

village-guard.name: Village Guard
village-guard.description: A larger defensive muster trained around the Village's prepared barriers and alarms.

technology.title: Knowledge Web
technology.introduction: Turn familiar practices into reliable traditions. Choose any destination; its required path is planned automatically and partial progress is never lost.
technology.affinity: Cultural familiarity: +{percent}% Knowledge output in {branch} research.
technology.noAffinity: No cultural familiarity bonus applies to this branch.
technology.pausedQueued: The plan is queued. Research advances when world time is running.
technology.automaticPath: Locked destinations automatically plan a deterministic prerequisite-first route.

seasonal-lore.name: Seasonal Lore
seasonal-lore.description: Record migrations, weather, and ripening cycles as a shared seasonal forecast.

cooperative-hunts.name: Cooperative Hunts
cooperative-hunts.description: Turn individual hunting skill into coordinated drives with roles and rally signals.

cordage-basketry.name: Cordage & Basketry
cordage-basketry.description: Standardize fibres, knots, nets, snares, and containers for repeated production.
cordage-basketry.unlock: Nets, carrying gear, and stronger ranged readiness

ground-stone-tools.name: Ground-Stone Tools
ground-stone-tools.description: Make reliable querns, mortars, and durable ground edges from suitable stone.

hearthcraft.name: Hearthcraft
hearthcraft.description: Maintain safer, hotter hearths for communal cooking, warmth, and preservation trials.

council-customs.name: Council Customs
council-customs.description: Establish a repeatable forum for shared work, disputes, and first diplomacy.

food-preservation.name: Food Preservation
food-preservation.description: Dry and smoke seasonal surpluses into dependable stores and expedition rations.

plant-tending.name: Plant Tending
plant-tending.description: Protect and selectively harvest useful wild stands without requiring agriculture.
plant-tending.unlock: Managed wild plots and selective harvests

animal-taming.name: Animal Taming
animal-taming.description: Capture, corral, and evaluate locally manageable animals over time.

hafted-polished-tools.name: Hafted & Polished Tools
hafted-polished-tools.description: Fit durable polished edges to handles for efficient timber and building work.
hafted-polished-tools.unlock: Polished tools and stronger close-warband attacks

permanent-dwellings.name: Permanent Dwellings
permanent-dwellings.description: Replace temporary shelter with maintained homes and resident work spaces.
permanent-dwellings.unlock: Durable dwellings and permanent Camp status

oral-tradition.name: Oral Tradition
oral-tradition.description: Give lorekeepers a formal role in teaching routes, events, and customary practice.

trail-networks.name: Trail Networks
trail-networks.description: Connect repeated routes into recognized corridors with known rests and hazards.
trail-networks.unlock: Marked routes and stronger beaten paths

warband-discipline.name: Warband Discipline
warband-discipline.description: Train coordinated rallying, formations, and controlled raids instead of loose violence.
warband-discipline.unlock: Warbands, rally points, and controlled raids

field-cultivation.name: Field Cultivation
field-cultivation.description: Sow and tend placeable fields whose yield depends on soil, moisture, season, and labour.

herd-management.name: Herd Management
herd-management.description: Manage reproducing herds through grazing routes, seasonal movement, and culling.
herd-management.unlock: Herds, grazing routes, and pastoral movement

pottery.name: Pottery
pottery.description: Shape and fire local clay into cooking and household storage vessels.

weaving.name: Weaving
weaving.description: Organize spinning and weaving into repeatable textile and net production.
weaving.unlock: Textiles, bindings, and better warband protection

communal-storage.name: Communal Storage
communal-storage.description: Pool preserved food in managed reserves that can outlast a poor season.

village-planning.name: Village Planning
village-planning.description: Lay out permanent work zones, shared infrastructure, and space for a growing population.

watercraft.name: Watercraft
watercraft.description: Build rafts and logboats for crossings, waterborne scouting, fishing, and cargo.

ritual-architecture.name: Ritual Architecture
ritual-architecture.description: Coordinate communal monuments and gathering spaces without requiring agriculture.

water-management.name: Water Management
water-management.description: Organize wells, cisterns, drainage, and small diversions where terrain permits.

kiln-firing.name: Kiln Firing
kiln-firing.description: Control hotter, repeatable firings for durable ceramics and experimental materials.

mining-quarrying.name: Mining & Quarrying
mining-quarrying.description: Prospect and extract toolstone and building stone beyond easy surface finds.
mining-quarrying.unlock: Mines, quarries, and bulk stone extraction

defensive-earthworks.name: Defensive Earthworks
defensive-earthworks.description: Coordinate ditches, berms, palisades, watch points, and defensive musters.

tallies-measures.name: Tallies & Measures
tallies-measures.description: Make stores, obligations, exchanges, and building estimates auditable.
tallies-measures.unlock: Tallies, standard measures, and work quotas

exchange-networks.name: Exchange Networks
exchange-networks.description: Turn occasional barter into recurring routes, guest-right, and knowledge diffusion.
exchange-networks.unlock: Recurring exchange routes and distant contacts

craft-specialization.name: Craft Specialization
craft-specialization.description: Support dedicated workshops, apprenticeships, and standardized batch production.

village-administration.name: Village Administration
village-administration.description: Separate local stewardship, learned counsel, and customary authority into dependable Village roles.

copper-working.name: Copper Working
copper-working.description: Cold-work and anneal scarce native copper while experimenting with ore and kiln heat.
copper-working.unlock: Copper fittings, elite loadouts, and the Chalcolithic transition
